literal: On jiwei day, it was learned that the envoys sent to announce and reassure the Uyghur, Heliege guodu Li, Yali, and others had been detained by Zhubugu; an edict ordered Susa to grant Zhubugu goods and coins and explain the court's intent to draw the distant near; the envoys were thereby able to proceed.
idiomatic: On jiwei day word came that envoys sent to announce policy to the Uyghur, Heliege guodu Li, Yali, and others had been detained by Zhubugu; an edict ordered Susa to present Zhubugu with gifts and explain the court's wish to win over distant peoples, and the envoys were then allowed to continue.

literal: On guihai day, Military Commissioner Han Pige, Hanlin Academician Xing Baopu, and others were appointed Yunzhou Announcement and Pacification commissioners.
idiomatic: On guihai day Military Commissioner Han Pige, Hanlin academician Xing Baopu, and others were appointed Yunzhou announcement and pacification commissioners.

literal: On bingyin day the captives taken by Grand Preceptor Wang Ba were divided and granted to Consort Zhao and yuyue Dilian Yiliwan.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the prisoners taken by Grand Preceptor Wang Ba were divided and distributed to Consort Zhao and yuyue Dilian Yiliwan.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingzi day, Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen sent attendants Nielidi and Gan Qinge to report the recovery of Shuozhou and the capture of Song general Yang Jiye, and to present the seals, cords, patents, and orders taken by the Emperor; Nielidi and others were granted wine and silver vessels.
idiomatic: On bingzi day in the seventh autumn month Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen sent attendants Nielidi and Gan Qinge to report the recovery of Shuozhou and the capture of Song general Yang Jiye and to present the seals, cords, patents, and orders taken by the Emperor; Nielidi and the others received wine and silver vessels.

literal: On xinsi day victory was announced to Heaven and Earth.
idiomatic: On xinsi day the court announced the victory to Heaven and Earth.

literal: Two hundred forty Song subjects who had submitted were divided and granted to the accompanying ministers.
idiomatic: Two hundred forty Song subjects who had submitted were divided among the accompanying ministers.

literal: Also, because many enemies had been killed, an edict ordered a Buddhist service for one month at Shangjing's Kailong Monastery and feeding ten thousand monks.
idiomatic: Because so many enemies had been killed, an edict also ordered a month-long Buddhist service at Shangjing's Kailong Monastery and the feeding of ten thousand monks.

literal: On xinmao day Xiezhen reported that the main army had reached Weizhou and encamped to the left of the prefecture.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Xiezhen reported that the main army had reached Weizhou and encamped west of the prefecture seat.

literal: Receiving a spy report that enemy troops were about to arrive, an ambush was set to wait.
idiomatic: On receiving a spy report that enemy troops were approaching, he laid an ambush and waited.

literal: When the enemy arrived, troops were released to counterattack; pursuing the routed foe northward, they reached Flying Fox Pass.
idiomatic: When the enemy arrived he counterattacked, pursued the fleeing force northward, and drove it as far as Flying Fox Pass.

literal: Then, pressing the advantage, they advanced westward with drums beating.
idiomatic: Then, pressing the advantage, the army advanced westward to the beat of drums.

literal: They entered Huanzhou and killed more than a thousand defending officials and soldiers.
idiomatic: They entered Huanzhou and killed more than a thousand defending officials and soldiers.

literal: Song general Yang Jiye had at first prided himself on martial prowess and was called Yang the Invincible; holding Yun and Shuozhou and several prefectures in the north, at this time he led troops south thirty li from Shuozhou to Langya Village; disliking the name, he would not advance;
idiomatic: Song general Yang Jiye had prided himself on martial prowess and was called Yang the Invincible; holding Yun, Shuozhou, and several northern prefectures, he now led his force thirty li south from Shuozhou to Langya Village, but disliking the name he refused to go farther;

literal: His attendants urgently pleaded, and only then did he proceed.
idiomatic: His attendants pressed him again and again before he went on.

literal: He encountered Xiezhen; ambushes rose on every side; he was struck by an arrow, fell from his horse, and was captured.
idiomatic: He met Xiezhen; ambushes sprang up on every side; struck by an arrow he fell from his horse and was taken.

literal: His wounds festered; he ate nothing and died after three days.
idiomatic: His wounds festered; he took no food and died after three days.

literal: His head was then placed in a box and presented.
idiomatic: His head was then boxed and sent up as tribute.

literal: An edict ordered xiangwen Xia Maishi to convey the head to yuyue Xiuge to show the armies and also to announce the Shuozhou victory to the officers of Nanjing and Pingzhou.
idiomatic: An edict ordered xiangwen Xia Maishi to carry the head to yuyue Xiuge for display to the armies and to announce the Shuozhou victory to the officers of Nanjing and Pingzhou.

literal: From this time Song defenders of Yun, Ying, and other prefectures, hearing of Jiye's death, all abandoned their cities and fled.
idiomatic: From then on Song defenders of Yun, Ying, and the other prefectures, hearing that Jiye was dead, all abandoned their cities and fled.

literal: In the eighth month, on the dingyou new moon, six xianli talan posts were established to oversee officials on the registers from the Yugu Li, Jurchen, Dilie Yu, and other divisions.
idiomatic: On the dingyou new moon of the eighth month six xianli talan posts were established to oversee officials on the registers from the Yugu Li, Jurchen, Dilie Yu, and other divisions.

literal: Northern Great King Pununing was made overseer of the five prefectures west of the mountains.
idiomatic: Northern Great King Pununing was appointed overseer of the five prefectures west of the mountains.

literal: On yisi day Han Derang memorialized that in prefectures and districts plundered by Song troops the grain left by fleeing commoners should be gathered by recruitment, with half given to the gatherers; it was approved.
idiomatic: On yisi day Han Derang memorialized that in prefectures and districts plundered by Song troops grain abandoned by fleeing commoners should be gathered by hired labor, with half given to those who gathered it, and the court agreed.

literal: On yimao day Xiezhen returned from the army and presented captives.
idiomatic: On yimao day Xiezhen returned from campaign and presented prisoners.

literal: On jiwei day, acting on the words of Shifang and Han Derang, this year's land tax in Shanxi was remitted.
idiomatic: On jiwei day, on the advice of Shifang and Han Derang, this year's land tax in Shanxi was remitted.

literal: An edict ordered that the merits and faults of the generals and officers in Shanxi be ranked and rewarded or punished accordingly.
idiomatic: An edict ordered the merits and faults of Shanxi generals and officers to be ranked and rewarded or punished accordingly.

literal: Yishi tent chancellor Anning, whose merit and fault were equal, had one patent of office revoked;
idiomatic: Yishi tent chancellor Anning, whose merit and fault balanced out, had one patent of office revoked;

literal: Diju division Military Commissioner Fonu was flogged fifty blows.
idiomatic: Diju division Military Commissioner Fonu was flogged fifty blows.

literal: Tihu Yaosheng, zhailie Lie, Shuozhou Military Commissioner Shensi, Yingzhou Military Commissioner Guzhi, Yunzhou Military Commissioner Huage, army officer Li Yuandi, Weizhou Military Commissioner Foliu, overseer Cui Qi, and Liu Jichen all had their offices stripped for fleeing on hearing of the enemy;
idiomatic: Tihu Yaosheng, zhailie Lie, Shuozhou Military Commissioner Shensi, Yingzhou Military Commissioner Guzhi, Yunzhou Military Commissioner Huage, army officer Li Yuandi, Weizhou Military Commissioner Foliu, overseer Cui Qi, and Liu Jichen all lost their posts for fleeing when they heard of the enemy;

literal: Lie was further assigned to his native register;
idiomatic: Lie was further assigned to his native register;

literal: Imperial In-law Army commander Wang Liu was flogged fifty blows.
idiomatic: Imperial In-law Army commander Wang Liu was flogged fifty blows.

literal: On renxu day the generals and officers under Xiezhen, who had first broken the Jurchen and later won victory over Song, were ranked by merit and given added rewards.
idiomatic: On renxu day the generals and officers under Xiezhen, who had first defeated the Jurchen and later won victory over Song, were ranked by merit and given added rewards.

literal: On guihai day Xiezhen was promoted to Grand Preceptor.
idiomatic: On guihai day Xiezhen was promoted to Grand Preceptor.

literal: In the ninth month, on the bingyin new moon, the Grand Consort, having presented gifts after the Empress's investiture, further sent clothing, camels, and horses to assist the marriage gifts and distributions.
idiomatic: On the bingyin new moon of the ninth month the Grand Consort, having already presented gifts after the Empress's investiture, further sent clothing, camels, and horses to assist the marriage gifts and distributions.

literal: On jiaxu day the court halted at Black River; on the Double Ninth it climbed high on the southern hill of Gaoshui and sacrificed to Heaven.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day the court halted at Black River; on the Double Ninth the Emperor climbed the southern hill at Gaoshui and sacrificed to Heaven.

literal: Chrysanthemum wine was granted to the accompanying ministers' wives.
idiomatic: Chrysanthemum wine was granted to the wives of the accompanying ministers.

literal: On dingchou day the court halted north of Heyang.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the court encamped north of Heyang.

literal: On wuyin day inner and outer titled ladies presented marriage gifts.
idiomatic: On wuyin day inner and outer titled ladies presented marriage gifts.

literal: On xinsi day Empress Xiao was invested.
idiomatic: On xinsi day Empress Xiao was invested.

literal: On bingxu day the court halted at Ru Prefecture; because the main army was about to campaign south, an edict ordered Pishi xiangwen Qidi and langjun zhailie to go ahead to their armies to repair armor and weapons.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the court halted at Ru Prefecture; with the main army preparing to march south, an edict ordered Pishi xiangwen Qidi and langjun zhailie to go ahead to their armies to repair armor and weapons.

literal: On jichou day Northern Great King Pununing was summoned to the imperial camp.
idiomatic: On jichou day Northern Great King Pununing was summoned to the imperial camp.

literal: On jiawu day the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth rite.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth rite.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on the bingchen new moon, the Tangut and Zubu sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the tenth winter month the Tangut and Zubu sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager again performed the rebirth rite to sacrifice to the spirits and pray for the Emperor's blessing.
idiomatic: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager again performed the rebirth rite, sacrificing to the spirits to pray for the Emperor's blessing.

literal: On jihai day Yishi royal tent langjun Wuliu was made Censor-in-Chief.
idiomatic: On jihai day Yishi royal tent langjun Wuliu was appointed censor-in-chief.

literal: Chief Councillor Shifang memorialized that since the Song invasion the people of the four Shanxi prefectures had been displaced and bandits had multiplied, and requested that the authorities be ordered to forbid this;
idiomatic: Chief councillor Shifang memorialized that since the Song invasion the people of the four Shanxi prefectures had been displaced and banditry had spread, and asked that the authorities be ordered to suppress it;

literal: Xinzhou Military Commissioner Puda Li was ordered to select men to patrol by separate routes.
idiomatic: Xinzhou Military Commissioner Puda Li was ordered to select men to patrol by separate routes.

literal: Northern Great King tent langjun Hegu Zhili reported seventeen crimes of his prince Pununing; an edict ordered Horizontal Tent Grand Guardian Heguo to investigate and try him.
idiomatic: Northern Great King tent langjun Hegu Zhili reported seventeen crimes committed by his prince Pununing; an edict ordered Horizontal Tent Grand Guardian Heguo to investigate and try him.

literal: Pununing confessed to eleven crimes and was flogged twenty blows and released.
idiomatic: Pununing confessed to eleven of the charges and was flogged twenty blows and released.

literal: Hegu Zhili also confessed to six counts of false accusation and was ordered to have his punishment carefully determined.
idiomatic: Hegu Zhili also confessed to six counts of false accusation and was ordered to receive a carefully determined punishment.

literal: Clerk Qinde was punished by association: beaten one hundred blows and dismissed from office.
idiomatic: Clerk Qinde was punished by association: beaten one hundred blows and dismissed from office.

literal: On jiachen day the court passed out through Juyong Pass.
idiomatic: On jiachen day the court passed out through Juyong Pass.

literal: On yisi day an edict ordered the various capitals and garrison towns to march in succession with the army and temporarily suspend handling minor affairs.
idiomatic: On yisi day an edict ordered the various capitals and garrison towns to march in succession with the army and temporarily suspend routine minor business.

literal: On gengxu day zhailie were dispatched along the border to scout.
idiomatic: On gengxu day zhailie were dispatched along the border to scout.

literal: On xinhai day the imperial clan's Lu tent was ordered to encamp at Eastern Capital Yanfang Marsh.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the imperial clan's Lu tent was ordered to encamp at Eastern Capital Yanfang Marsh.

literal: On renzi day an edict ordered that an imperial patent be delivered to yuyue Xiuge to announce the southern campaign to the six prefectures south of the Juma River.
idiomatic: On renzi day an edict ordered an imperial patent delivered to yuyue Xiuge to announce the southern campaign to the six prefectures south of the Juma River.

literal: On yimao day he visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: On yimao day the Emperor visited Nanjing.

literal: On wuwu day, on the word of Southern Court Great King Liuning, this year's land tax of the Southern Court divisions was remitted.
idiomatic: On wuwu day, on memorial from Southern Court Great King Liuning, this year's land tax of the Southern Court divisions was remitted.

literal: On renxu day silver sable, blue sable, and other goods were granted to capital officials, monks and Daoists, and elders.
idiomatic: On renxu day silver sable, blue sable, and other goods were granted to capital officials, monks and Daoists, and elders.

literal: On jiazi day the Emperor and the great ministers divided into teams and played cuju.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the Emperor and the great ministers divided into teams and played cuju.

literal: In the eleventh month, on the bingyin new moon, the Tangut came with tribute.
idiomatic: On the bingyin new moon of the eleventh month the Tangut came with tribute.

literal: On gengwu day Chief Councillor Han Derang was promoted to Grand Preceptor.
idiomatic: On gengwu day Chief Councillor Han Derang was promoted to Grand Preceptor.

literal: On renshen day, because levies at Gubei, Songting, and Yugu Pass were unlawful and blocked merchants and travelers, envoys were dispatched to investigate.
idiomatic: On renshen day, because levies at Gubei, Songting, and Yugu Pass were unlawful and blocked merchants and travelers, envoys were sent to investigate.

literal: The Jurchen requested to follow the campaign with troops; it was granted.
idiomatic: The Jurchen asked to follow the campaign with troops, and the request was granted.

literal: On guiyou day he held court in the Main Hall and greatly rewarded the southern campaign generals and officers.
idiomatic: On guiyou day the Emperor held court in the Main Hall and greatly rewarded the southern campaign generals and officers.

literal: On bingzi day the southern expedition halted at Xiadi Pass; the Empress Dowager newly inspected the baggage train, armor, and weapons.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the southern expedition halted at Xiadi Pass, and the Empress Dowager newly inspected the baggage train, armor, and weapons.

literal: On dingchou day Xiuge was made vanguard commander-in-chief.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Xiuge was appointed vanguard commander-in-chief.

literal: On wuyin day, the winter solstice, the Emperor led the accompanying ministers to sacrifice and offer wine before Emperor Jingzong's portrait.
idiomatic: On wuyin day, the winter solstice, the Emperor led the accompanying ministers to sacrifice and offer wine before Emperor Jingzong's portrait.

literal: On xinsi day an edict ordered Northern Great King Pununing to reside at Fengsheng Prefecture and jointly decide all public business of the five Shanxi prefectures with Military Commissioner Puda Li.
idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict ordered Northern Great King Pununing to reside at Fengsheng Prefecture and jointly decide all public business of the five Shanxi prefectures with Military Commissioner Puda Li.

literal: On guiwei day the sun and moon were sacrificed to to pray for the blessing of Imperial Son-in-law Commander Qinde.
idiomatic: On guiwei day the court sacrificed to the sun and moon to pray for the blessing of Imperial Son-in-law Commander Qinde.

literal: On yiyou day overseers of the various divisions were established, ordering each division to keep to its own camp and not mix ranks.
idiomatic: On yiyou day overseers of the various divisions were established, ordering each division to keep to its own camp and not mix ranks.

literal: On bingxu day Molugu and Imperial Son-in-law Xiao Jiyuan were dispatched to patrol the border.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Molugu and Imperial Son-in-law Xiao Jiyuan were dispatched to patrol the border.

literal: Captured Song soldiers were used to shoot ghost arrows.
idiomatic: Captured Song soldiers were used to shoot ghost arrows.

literal: On dinghai day the blue ox and white horse were sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
idiomatic: On dinghai day the court sacrificed the blue ox and white horse to Heaven and Earth.

literal: On xinmao day the court halted at White Pagoda River; a tame fox that had come of itself was taken as a lucky sign, and Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the court halted at White Pagoda River; a tame fox that had come of itself was taken as a lucky sign, and Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to.

literal: An edict ordered Imperial Son-in-law Xiao Jiyuan, yuyue Molugu, and Grand Preceptor Lin Ba to hold the frontier firm and let no spies slip through.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Imperial Son-in-law Xiao Jiyuan, yuyue Molugu, and Grand Preceptor Lin Ba to hold the frontier firm and let no spies slip through.

literal: In the army no one might gallop without cause, nor might the troops wantonly destroy mulberry trees and fruit in the southern borderlands.
idiomatic: In the army no one might gallop without cause, nor might the troops wantonly destroy mulberry trees and fruit in the southern borderlands.

literal: On renchen day the army reached Tangxing County.
idiomatic: On renchen day the army reached Tangxing County.

literal: At that time Song troops were encamped north of the Hutuo Bridge; selected officers shot at them in disorder; the bridge could not be held, and they advanced and burned it.
idiomatic: At that time Song troops were encamped north of the Hutuo Bridge; selected officers shot at them in disorder; the bridge could not be held, and the Liao force advanced and burned it.

literal: On guisi day they crossed the Sha River; Xiuge came to discuss military affairs.
idiomatic: On guisi day they crossed the Sha River, and Xiuge came to discuss military affairs.

literal: Northern Pishi xiangwen Paiya presented two captured Song spies; the Emperor granted them clothing and ordered them back to win over Taizhou.
idiomatic: Northern Pishi xiangwen Paiya presented two captured Song spies; the Emperor granted them clothing and ordered them back to win over Taizhou.

literal: Chute division Military Commissioner Lubugu and overseer Yelü Pan fought Song at Taizhou with an unfavorable outcome.
idiomatic: Chute division Military Commissioner Lubugu and overseer Yelü Pan fought Song at Taizhou and were defeated.

literal: On jiawu day the Milu Spirit was sacrificed to.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the court sacrificed to the Milu Spirit.

literal: Because Lubugu had fled in battle, one patent of office was revoked;
idiomatic: Because Lubugu had fled in battle, one patent of office was revoked;

literal: his administrative assistant and overseer were each beaten with the staff.
idiomatic: his administrative assistant and overseer were each beaten with the staff.

literal: Langjun zhailie Shuang Guli encountered Song vanguard at Wangdu, captured nine of their soldiers, and took eleven suits of armor and horses; he was granted wine and silver vessels.
idiomatic: Langjun zhailie Shuang Guli encountered the Song vanguard at Wangdu, captured nine soldiers, and took eleven suits of armor and horses; he received wine and silver vessels.

literal: On yiwei day an edict announced the crimes of Lubugu and others to the armies.
idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict announced the crimes of Lubugu and others to the armies.

literal: Yuzhan langjun Huage was made acting Chute division Military Commissioner and Horizontal Tent langjun Foliu overseer, replacing Lubugu.
idiomatic: Yuzhan langjun Huage was made acting Chute division military commissioner and Horizontal Tent langjun Foliu overseer, replacing Lubugu.

literal: Acting Imperial In-law Army commander Tao Wei requested that two officers be appointed to command scattered soldiers; an edict appointed langjun Yiyin, Pode, and others.
idiomatic: Acting Imperial In-law Army commander Tao Wei asked that two officers be appointed to command scattered soldiers; an edict appointed langjun Yiyin, Pode, and others.

literal: Zhangde Army Military Commissioner Xiao Talan and General Dizi were ordered to sweep the eastern route.
idiomatic: Zhangde Army Military Commissioner Xiao Talan and General Dizi were ordered to sweep the eastern route.

literal: An edict ordered Xiuge, Paiya, and others to discuss military affairs.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Xiuge, Paiya, and others to discuss military affairs.

literal: In the twelfth month, on jihai day, Xiuge defeated the Song army at Wangdu and sent men to present captives.
idiomatic: On jihai day in the twelfth month Xiuge defeated the Song army at Wangdu and sent men to present prisoners.

literal: On renyin day the army encamped north of the Hutuo; an edict ordered Xiuge to use cavalry to cut off the Song army and not let it enter Xingzhou;
idiomatic: On renyin day the army encamped north of the Hutuo; an edict ordered Xiuge to use cavalry to cut off the Song army and keep it from entering Xingzhou;

literal: Grand Preceptor Wang Liu was ordered to scout.
idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Wang Liu was ordered to scout.

literal: On guimao day junior officer He Zhu encountered Song baggage train, led troops to kill and capture in great numbers, and also burned their fodder and grain.
idiomatic: On guimao day junior officer He Zhu encountered a Song baggage train, led troops to kill and capture in great numbers, and burned their fodder and grain.

literal: On jiachen day an edict ordered the Southern Great King to join forces with Xiuge in advance and chancellor Anning to command the Dilie division and the Three Ke armies as rear guard.
idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict ordered the Southern Great King to join Xiuge in a combined advance and Chancellor Anning to command the Dilie division and the Three Ke armies as rear guard.

literal: The Emperor led the main army and fought Song generals Liu Tingrang and Li Jingyuan at Mo Prefecture and defeated them.
idiomatic: The Emperor led the main army against Song generals Liu Tingrang and Li Jingyuan at Mo Prefecture and defeated them.

literal: On yisi day Song generals He Lingtu and Yang Chongjin and others were captured.
idiomatic: On yisi day Song generals He Lingtu, Yang Chongjin, and others were captured.

literal: Imperial In-law xiangwen Taliege and Palace Attendant Xiao Dali died in battle.
idiomatic: Imperial In-law xiangwen Taliege and Palace Attendant Xiao Dali died in battle.

literal: On bingwu day an edict ordered Xiuge and those below him to enter the inner hall and granted them wine in reward.
idiomatic: On bingwu day an edict summoned Xiuge and his subordinates into the inner hall and granted them wine in reward.

literal: On dingwei day a victory mound was built.
idiomatic: On dingwei day a victory mound was built.
